a971ba710c8bc517f8b227c7 description: Glukhar's Reserve network is a command problem, not a body-count exercise. Eliminate the command node once and break the chain.
a971ba710c8bc517f8b227c7 note: High-value target operation. One confirmed elimination; no repeat ladder.
a971ba710c8bc517f8b227c7 startedMessageT: Reserve has a command structure that keeps surviving because operators treat it like random contact. I want the opposite. Find Glukhar, remove him once, and leave before the base turns the operation into a war of attrition.
a971ba710c8bc517f8b227c7 successMessageT: The command node is gone. That is enough. No second tally, no inflated quota. You proved you can execute a deliberate strike.
a971ba710c8bc517f8b227c7 acceptPlayerMes: Take the Reserve contract. One target: Glukhar. Precision matters more than a pile of bodies.
a971ba710c8bc517f8b227c7 completePlayerM: Operation complete. Your standing reflects it, and the intelligence package is yours.
